mapper.select: SELECT id, type_code AS typeCode, type_name AS typeName, type_category AS typeCategory, CASE type_category WHEN 'sensor' THEN '传感器' WHEN 'controller' THEN '控制器' WHEN 'gateway' THEN '网关' ELSE '其他' END AS typeCategoryText, icon, protocol, manufacturer, model, spec_json AS specJson, status, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN '正常' ELSE '禁用' END AS statusText, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime FROM agri_iot_device_type WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM agri_iot_device_type WHERE type_code = #{typeCode} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT id, type_code AS typeCode, type_name AS typeName, type_category AS typeCategory, CASE type_category WHEN 'sensor' THEN '传感器' WHEN 'controller' THEN '控制器' WHEN 'gateway' THEN '网关' ELSE '其他' END AS typeCategoryText, icon, protocol, manufacturer, model, status, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN '正常' ELSE '禁用' END AS statusText FROM agri_iot_device_type WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, create_time DESC
